item.title: Pushing back on Recent ‘Sea Level is Worse Now’ Claims: The Coordinate System That Ate the Coastline
item.description: The moral of the story may be that Earth’s oceans are less volatile than our coordinate systems. While the water creeps upward at a stately pace measured in millimetres per year, the reference frames used to describe it can shift by centimetres or metres depending on the choice of model.

Then Donald Trump returned to the White House and quickly set about canceling the entire agenda—and he’s still not done. And the climate alarmists are confused. Where is the pushback?

item.title: Ghostwriters for the Courts: The Climate Litigation Network Behind a Withdrawn Judicial Manual
item.description: The deeper issue is that climate science, climate policy, and climate litigation have become part of the same institutional machinery. And once those gears start turning together, separating scientific analysis from legal strategy becomes nearly impossible.

item.title: Another Confusing Story Highlights Why Climate Hysteria and Far-Left Media Are Reaching Their End
item.description: It never occurs to the far-left (formerly mainstream) media that its demise might be attributable to more than economic factors or the rise of the internet. Just as important is the clear bias and agenda- driven politics that resulted in a loss of trust by millions of Americans who are not part of the far-left bubble that the media increasingly served.

item.title: ‘Peak Rock’: The ONION Goes Neo-Malthusian (Fixity/ depletion curse expands)
item.description: “Take the Rocky Mountains, for example: There’s plenty of rocks right there,” Colorado resident Kyle Peters said. “It’s our right as Americans to use as many rocks as we need for whatever purposes we decide, and no scientist is going to scare me into thinking otherwise.”
